description: Pontos de Captação de Água em Mananciais de Abastecimento Público do Estado do Rio de Janeiro is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Os Pontos de Captação de Água do Estado do Rio de Janeiro consistem em 199 captações em corpos hídricos superficiais que, através de sistemas isolados ou integrados, constituem mananciais estratégicos para o abastecimento das 92 sedes do Estado do Rio de Janeiro e atendem cerca de 94% da população fluminense. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are environment, inlandWaters. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
